title: Navigating the Pitfalls of Active Learning Evaluation: A Systematic Framework for Meaningful Performance Assessment
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical evaluation of Active Learning methods, identifying pitfalls in current evaluation protocols (P1-P5: data distribution, starting budgets, query sizes, classifier configuration, alternative training paradigms). It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as its main subject. While good evaluation practices might contribute to more 'ethical' AI development in a very broad sense, this is not the specific focus of the paper.
